artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: The late-day SWEEP pass (DQ-t-77). run(..., sweep=True) dispatches to _run_sweep before the default trading-day gate, so the sweep draws on trading days too. The sweep's room is budgets.daily_total less production's spend (the day's production budget ledger, read with bbg_ledger_upload.rows_for_day, the drawer's own modes excluded, a None-cells row counted at its rows and its mode listed) less every actuals cell dated the day (_sweep_room). An absent or unreadable production ledger reads 0 with reason PRODUCTION_SPEND_UNREAD and no draw. The sweep's only history cap is daily_total_left: the surface rooms and the untagged ceiling are waived; draw_hold, the tier floor, the probe rules, the empty-window cooldown, the per-request outcome and every vendor stop are kept (the sweep reuses _draw_history and _draw_reference unchanged). Its marker run.<day>.sweep.started.json is written before the first draw and never removed (ALREADY_RAN_TODAY on a second sweep). Its receipt and parquets are receipt.<day>.sweep.json, history-<day>.sweep.parquet and reference-<day>.sweep.parquet. --room --sweep (sweep_view) and --task-name --sweep (sweep_task_name, mdpf-demque-sweep-daily) are read only. The default pass is unchanged. Not deployed: DQ-t-78 registers the 16:00 ET task at site Z; this cell registers nothing.
